package_manifest.title: CSTrainer: An Ontology Driven Multiple AIGC Agentic Approach For Oil And Gas Scientific Research Supporting
package_manifest.description: Standardized skill package containing all 6 core skills, global execution rules, and multi-agent coordination protocols for the CSTrainer AI4S Engine.

task_scale_limit.rule_description: Strictly restrict squeezed research questions to 3-5 to maintain research focus and prevent task volatility.

human_in_the_loop_bounds.over_limit_strategy: Switch to binary feedback mode (0/1) to minimize interaction noise and goal drift.

skills.target_stage: Stage 1 - Research Intent Parsing & Direction Squeezing
skills.role: You are an expert machine learning research engineer specializing in scientific idea synthesis, domain-specific oil & gas ontology alignment, and technical writing.
skills.task: From the given I_top and historical trajectory P, extract promising research directions that are reusable and instructive for future investigation.

operation_steps.name: Extract Directions
operation_steps.description: Analyze each I_top and historical context P, and abstract its core research paradigm.

operation_steps.name: Generate Structured Entries
operation_steps.description: Create a structured entry for each direction containing required components.
components: Clear Title: Summarize the direction in one sentence.
Core Mechanism / Hypothesis: The key scientific principle or technical pathway underlying the direction.
Prospect Justification: Explain why it represents a scientific problem worth refining for user goal G across four dimensions: novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity.
Key Requirements and Assumptions: Data, computational resources, domain tools (e.g., Eclipse, SCADA, Well-logs), or environments required to implement this direction.
Minimal Validation Experiment Plan: List the 2-4 most critical steps for rapidly verifying the feasibility of this direction.

constraints.question_scale: Strictly squeeze and focus on 3-5 core research questions to prevent task volatility.
constraints.hallucination_control: Constrain reasoning paths strictly within domain-specific static ontology entities.

skills.output_format: Merge similar directions, ensure precise, concise, and actionable wording, and enable direct future retrieval and workflow integration.

skills.target_stage: Stage 2 & Stage 3 - Hypothesis Verification & Negative Feedback Loop
skills.role: You are a rigorous scientific research auditor and domain ontology supervisor.
skills.task: Analyze the experiment report W against proposal P, determine whether proposal P has failed, and summarize lessons learned from it.
judgment_logic: If the engineer finds no executable code in proposal P, then proposal P = failed.
If the experiment has been completed, but the performance of the proposed method is worse than the baseline method according to the indicator analysis in the report, then proposal P = failed.
skills.analysis_requirements: If judged as failed, conduct a detailed analysis of the root causes of the failure (e.g., invalid hypotheses, unavailable data, infeasible methods, insufficient computational resources, excessive interaction noise).

output_spec.destination: Unsuccessful directions library in idea memory

skills.target_stage: Stage 4 & Stage 5 - Code Compilation & Strategy Extraction

trigger_input.execution_history: Complete code search and execution history {H_E(S)}

skills.role: You are a senior full-stack engineer, domain AI architect, and code compiler.
skills.task: Distill reusable experimental strategies from successful code and the entire debugging trajectory.

analysis_focus.learn_from_best_code: From the best code C_best(S) with the best effect at each experimental stage s, extract its data preprocessing process, model construction mode, training skills, and hyperparameter setting strategy.
analysis_focus.learn_from_full_trajectory: Analyze the typical errors encountered during the entire search process and their solutions, and summarize debugging strategies and environment configuration experience.

categories: Data Processing Strategies (e.g., handling missing well logs, SCADA filtering)
Model Training Strategies (e.g., physics-informed loss constraints, transfer learning)

trigger_input.candidate_directions: List of N unrefined research candidates
trigger_input.domain_constraints: Static entity ontology and dynamic path rules

agent_roles.Planner: GPT-4o — Formulates overall strategy and structures the debate rounds.
agent_roles.Executor: DeepSeek-V4 — Proposes concrete technical routes and code implementations.
agent_roles.Debater: Qwen-3.5 — Challenges assumptions, highlights missing parameters, and tests edge cases.
agent_roles.Supervisor: Tencent-Hunyuan — Monitors ontology compliance and evaluates Bayesian entropy.
agent_roles.Judge: Doubao-Seed 7.0 & GPT-4o — Conducts cross-model voting and renders final decisions.

workflow: Round 1: Divergence — Executor proposes candidate hypotheses based on Athens RAG.
Round 2: Debate — Debater identifies technical flaws and domain ontology misalignments.
Round 3: Convergence — Supervisor evaluates consensus entropy and selects top contenders.
Round 4: Squeezing — Judge votes on final Top-3 to Top-5 research questions.
skills.tie_breaking_protocol: If cross-model voting results in a tie, GPT-4o acts as the Weighted Arbiter, aligning decisions directly with original user intent G.

skills.prompt_name: Dynamic Bayesian Trust Update and Evaluation

mathematical_formulation.posterior_correctness_formula: P(correct | V_i) = [P(V_i | correct) * P0] / [P(V_i | correct) * P0 + P(V_i | incorrect) * (1 - P0)]
mathematical_formulation.trust_update_formula: P_i(t+1) = P_i(t) * [ omega * P(correct | V_i) + (1 - omega) * sigma_i ]

parameters.P_i_t: Prior trust score of agent i at step t
parameters.omega: Weighting factor balancing judge consensus vs individual execution score (default = 0.6)
parameters.sigma_i: Execution performance score of agent i output (0.0 to 1.0)
parameters.V_i: Votes received by agent i proposal from judge cluster

skills.prompt_name: Domain Ontology Alignment and Knowledge Grounding

trigger_input.raw_llm_reasoning: Unfiltered reasoning chain or generated text

skills.role: You are a domain ontology referee and oil & gas knowledge graph architect.
alignment_rules: Verify every technical term against the static concept ontology (e.g., permeability, porosity, bottom-hole pressure).
Ensure dynamic process workflows adhere to physical boundary conditions (e.g., material balance equations, Darcy's Law).
Flag any synthetic or ungrounded entity claims as AIGC hallucinations and force reasoning trajectory recalculation.
skills.output_format: Mapped & grounded JSON graph specifying verified entities, dynamic relation links, and invalid hallucination flags.
